I went with this initially since it looks most similar to plain EM configs which folks are already familiar with.

Agree that the raw string literal messes up the formatting here and we're adding the parsing overhead.

Changed it to build up the json object step by step as per your idea.
Just make this a normal method.  lambdas without a capture should be only done inline.

Changed it to define an extra function there for each test 👍

The tradeoff is that it's now in scope for the other test cases, but it should not be too big of an issue if we stick to some naming scheme.
As you're adding these tests, do they all require all of these dependencies?  Can we deduplicate the lists please?
I guess this one does require all of them.
